set.body: Build the idiomatic user surface around ViewPlan: Field.to or Field.in for target domains; rows, vertices, voxels, roi, slice, and time-block selectors where the domain supports them; terminal value and materialize operations through explicit runtime or source capabilities. Acceptance: representative pipelines read as descriptions rather than compiler plumbing; descriptive calls remain lazy; invalid selections and incompatible domains fail through precise ADTs; compile-time distinctions are used where practical; examples cover volume-to-volume and volume-to-surface use without manually calling OperatorCompiler or FieldRuntime.view.
set.title: Spatial Field API: composable to, in, selection, value, and materialize
